whatThisPluginAdds.text: Location Map adds a Layout Builder widget for validated place markers with ordinary OpenStreetMap links and an optional interactive embed. The embed is loaded only after explicit activation and can respect Privacy Center decisions.

surfaceOutcome.text: Editors configure locations in Layout Builder, and visitors initially receive useful map links with the choice to activate the richer public map.

developers.text: The widget validates marker data and keeps third-party map loading behind an interaction and privacy-aware extension boundary.

teams.text: Teams can publish useful location details before asking visitors to load an external map experience.
